This role will be the senior lead contributor within the organization that creates, monitors, maintains, and enhances risk controls by analyzing quality data and major quality events to ensure Medline is properly controlling risks on a global level for medical devices, cosmetics, and OTC drugs.

This individual will collaborate with clinical, design engineering, regulatory, labeling, and international partners to ensure that risk is appropriately mitigated, evaluated, disclosed, and monitored. Provide expertise to the organization including education, technical support, issue resolution, and integration of new or enhanced risk controls to be compliant with EU MDR along with satisfying FDA, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971 risk management related processes throughout the product life cycle. • Effectively communicate risks to senior global management. Build effective relationships with quality and business partners.

• Identify inefficiencies in Medline’s global quality management system. Take action to address identified inefficiencies.

• Lead and ensure that deadlines and goals are being met.

• Proactively work with members of the division or project team to identify issues that might delay the project; make recommendations to improve timelines for project completion.

• Experience creating quality sub-systems and leading complex projects.

title: Azure (AVD) Engineer
description:
Job Profile: Azure (AVD) Engineer
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) & Endpoint Engineer to design,
implement, and manage enterprise-grade virtual desktop, endpoint, and storage solutions
in Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise across the
Azure ecosystem, with specialization in AVD, Nerdio Manager for Enterprise (NME), Intune,
FSLogix, and Azure storage. This role will be responsible for ensuring seamless user
experience, optimal cost-performance, and adherence to security and compliance
standards.
Key Responsibilities
Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD):
Design, deploy, and manage AVD host pools, session hosts, and application groups.
Configure and maintain golden images using Azure Compute Gallery.
Nerdio Manager for Enterprise (NME):
Implement and maintain auto-scaling and auto-healing policies for cost optimization and
high availability. Manage access, RBAC, and integration with Azure AD/Entra ID.
Azure Virtual Machines (VMs):
Provision, monitor, and optimize Azure VMs for scalability and resiliency. Ensure alignment
with workload requirements and performance baselines.
Profile & User Data Management:
Configure and manage FSLogix profile containers, including Office containers and Cloud
Cache, ensuring optimal performance and minimal login times.
Storage Solutions:
Administer Azure Files and Azure NetApp Files for user profiles, application data, and
enterprise workloads. Implement performance tuning, snapshots, and DR configurations.
Device & Endpoint Management:
Leverage Microsoft Intune to manage policies, compliance baselines, app deployment,
and Autopilot provisioning for virtual and physical devices.
Windows OS & Enterprise Integration:
Support Windows 10/11 environments, GPO-to-Intune migration, and ensure security
hardening and patch compliance across hybrid environments.
Automation & Troubleshooting:
Use PowerShell/Bicep/Terraform to automate deployments, scaling policies, and image
updates. Troubleshoot incidents across VDI, profiles, Intune, and storage layers.
Collaboration & Documentation:
Work closely with Infrastructure, Security, and EUC teams to ensure solutions meet
business requirements. Produce clear documentation and runbooks for support and
operations.
Required Skills & Experience
Core:
o Strong experience in Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) deployment and administration.
o Hands-on with Azure Virtual Machines (compute, networking, backup).
o Working knowledge of Azure Compute Gallery for image lifecycle management.
o Experience with Nerdio Manager for Enterprise (NME) (or deep AVD experience with
willingness to upskill).
o Expertise in NME Auto-Scaling and Auto-Healing configurations.
o Proficiency with Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM, Autopilot, compliance policies).
o Administration of FSLogix Profile Containers with Office 365 integration.
o Storage administration with Azure Files and/or Azure NetApp Files.
o Advanced knowledge of Windows OS (Windows 10/11) enterprise configuration.
Preferred/Desirable:
o Certifications: AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-140, MD-102, Nerdio certifications.
o PowerShell scripting, Bicep, or Terraform automation.
o Experience in enterprise/BPO/MSP environments with 24x7 support exposure.
o Understanding of Conditional Access, Entra ID, and hybrid identity.
o Strong troubleshooting skills across VDI, profiles, networking, and storage.
Education & Qualifications
bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field
(preferred).
Relevant Microsoft or Nerdio certifications highly desirable.
Soft Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication skills (English, written and spoken).
Ability to work in a fast-paced, multinational environment.
Strong teamwork and collaboration mindset.

• Work from product problem to shipped mobile experience, not just assigned screens.

• Improve app quality through production feedback, analytics, crash reports and user behaviour.

• Help raise the standard for mobile UX, reliability and speed across the product.

What We're Looking For

• Strong mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

• Experience shipping production mobile apps used by real users.

• Good product sense, UX judgement and attention to edge cases.

• Able to work across APIs, releases, debugging and production issues.

• Hands-on builder who can take ownership without heavy guidance.

• Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

• Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

• People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
